findings.note: He is one of the named senators on the as-passed text of SB 202 (2021 Election Integrity Act): "By: Senators Burns of the 23rd, Miller of the 49th, Dugan of the 30th, Ginn of the 47th, Anderson of the 24th and others". The text, among other changes, has the registrar compare the driver's license or state ID number on an absentee ballot envelope with voter records. His final votes of 2021-03-25 were not reachable.
